name: layout-containment
summary: Own the window: the shell never scrolls or under-fills
body:
Two related layout escapes: xterm's first fit in an unconstrained
container pushed the shell into document scrolling, and the previous
patch's html/body/#root height rule missed its anchor silently, so
the shell sized to content and left a dead band under the statusbar.
The height chain now lives in tokens.css (asserted on edit), every
fixed-size wrapper is a .pane-wrap with a complete min-size chain,
and each region scrolls only inside itself.
